hero.title: Avalanche Lexicon
hero.description: This lexicon maps the vocabulary of WWII testimony across Greek and Italian oral histories — exploring how women and men, Italians and Greeks, and different communities within Italy and Greece narrate the same catastrophe in different words.

corpora.label: 01 — The Archives
corpora.title: Five oral history collections
corpora.description: The lexicon draws on testimonies from five archives spanning Greece and Italy — each preserving a different facet of wartime and post-war memory.

themes.label: 02 — Thematic Landscape
themes.title: Browse by theme
themes.description: Every word in the lexicon belongs to one of these themes. Click a theme to see its words — then click any word to explore its concordances, collocations, and keyness profile.

explorer.label: 03 — Lexicon Explorer
explorer.title: Browse the full lexicon
explorer.description: Search, filter, and explore all headwords. Click any card for the full profile: concordances, collocations, and keyness data.

keywords.label: 04 — Distinctive Vocabulary
keywords.title: Words that set each group apart
keywords.description: Which words are used significantly more by one group than another? Higher scores mean the word is more characteristic of that group. Compare across archives, gender, and geography.

gender.label: 05 — Gendered Memory
gender.title: How men and women remember differently
gender.description: Which words do men and women use differently when giving testimony? Bars to the right mark words used more by women; bars to the left, words used more by men. Longer bars mean a stronger difference.

corpusColloc.label: 06 — Word Pairs
corpusColloc.title: Words that appear together
corpusColloc.description: Which words are regularly paired in testimony? Browse by grammatical pattern to see how nouns combine with other nouns, how adjectives describe nouns, which verbs go with which objects, and which people or places trigger which actions.

entities.label: 07 — Named Entities
entities.title: The people, places, and institutions of testimony
entities.description: Named entity recognition across 397 testimonies identified 46,664 entity mentions. The bars show how many testimonies reference each entity.

concordance.label: 08 — Concordance Search
concordance.title: Words in context
concordance.description: Search for any word and see the actual sentences where survivors used it. Each line shows the word highlighted in its original testimony context.

archives.name: United States Holocaust Memorial Museum
archives.description: Filmed testimonies of Holocaust survivors and witnesses.

archives.name: Istorima
archives.description: Oral history archive collecting life stories from people in Greece. Not exclusively Holocaust testimonies but broader life narratives.

archives.name: Memories of the Occupation in Greece
archives.description: Testimonies focused on the experience of German occupation in Greece, including resistance, famine, and daily life under occupation.

archives.name: CDEC — Italian Testimonies
archives.description: The Foundation for Contemporary Jewish Documentation in Milan preserves testimonies of Italian Jewish survivors. This corpus concerns testimonies from survivors and witnesses in Italy.

archives.name: CDEC — Rhodes Collection
archives.description: Testimonies from the Jewish community of Rhodes.
